The increasing investments by hyperscale and other cloud providers in AI datacenter infrastructures have significantly boosted demand for our datacenter transceivers. Revenue growth in our Datacenter business was fueled by continued strong AI datacenter demand, while our Communications business benefited from increased demand in both data center interconnect and traditional telecom applications. The increase in revenue of $226 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025 was due to increases in our Datacenter business driven primarily by continued strong AI datacenter demand and growth in our Communications business revenue due to higher demand in the data center interconnect as well as traditional telecom applications. The Company believes existing cash, cash flow from operations, and available borrowing capacity from its Senior Credit Facilities will be sufficient to fund its needs for working capital, capital expenditures, repayment of scheduled long-term borrowings and lease obligations, investments in R&D, and internal and external growth objectives at least through the next twelve months.
